page.layout: One page of text, with a running head and page number at the top. Below the running head: a heading "Notæ Memoriales", a numbered list in three rows, the heading "Declaratio.", three paragraphs of small type, a heading "Analysis Epistolæ II. ad Corinthios", and one body paragraph opening with a large initial. A gathering signature is at the foot. No margin notes on this page. The left strip of the scan is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Notæ Memoriales.
main_text.l: Rapax, Quisque suam, Idolü, Stadioque, Typique:
Nudus, Corporis, Aes, Lingua, Vivemus, Apollo.
main_text.head: Declaratio.
main_text.p: Schismata ne sint inter vos: v.10. Perfectos inter loquimur sapientiam: v.6. Laclis potu[?] alui vos: v.2. Purgamina mundi facti sumus; v.13. Massam paulum fermenti infermentat. v.6.

Rapax non possid b tregni[?] Dei hereditatem: v.10. Quisque suam uxorem habeto: v.2. Idolum nihil est in mundo: v.4. Stadioque qui currunt, ex iis unus accipit præmium: v.24. Typique ut hæc sint, acciderunt. v.6.

Nudus capite sit vir: v.7. Corporis & membrorum similitudo, v.12. Aes resonans est Ministerexpers charitatis. v.1. Lingua qui loquitur, Deo loquitur. v.2. Vivemus denuò in resurrectione. Apollo recusat adire Corinthios. v.12.
main_text.head: ANALYSIS EPISTO-LÆ II. AD CORIN-thios.
main_text.p: HÆc Epistola cum præcedenti rectè coniungitur. Nam etsi diversis tempori-bus & per diversas personas scriptæ & missæ sunt, prior per Fortunatum & Timotheum, po-sterior per Titum & Lucam, colligitur tamen ex hac Epistola fructus prioris Epistolæ, quæ inanis non fuit apud Corinthios, à quibus Ti-motheus benignè exceptus, excommunicatio

page.notes: The numbers 1–16 in the list are printed above the words of the memorial lines and are copied in the order they stand. The first letter of the running head is printed as a Roman I and is read as such. The page number reads 251; the top of the digit is faint. The word "tregni" in the Declaratio is printed with a broken letter and may be a damaged "regni". "Laclis potu" and "possid b" are doubtful and are marked [?]. The text of the first line of the body paragraph and the Declaratio are set in small type; no marginal notes are printed on this page.
